  PALOS VERDES ESTATES CITY COUNCIL
  ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING

Copies of the staff reports or other written documentation relating to each item of business
referred to on the agenda are on file in the office of the City Clerk and are available for
public inspection. If applicable, materials related to an item on this agenda submitted to the
Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City
Clerk’s office during normal business hours. Any person having any question concerning
any agenda item may call the City Clerk’s office (310-378-0383). Upon request, the agenda
and documents in the agenda packet can be made available in appropriate alternative
formats to persons with a disability in compliance with the Americans with Disabilities
Act. Please contact the City Clerk (310-378-0383), at least 48 hours prior to the meeting
to request a disability-related modification or accommodation.

minutes_text:
MINUTES OF AN ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF
  PALOS VERDES ESTATES, CALIFORNIA
  August 9, 2011

An adjourned regular meeting/policy session of the City Council of the City of Palos
Verdes Estates was called to order this day at 5:00 p.m. in the Community Room of the
Malaga Cove Library by Mayor Rea, followed by the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Goodhart, Humphrey, Perkins, Mayor Pro Tem
  Bird, and Mayor Rea.

ABSENT:  None

ALSO PRESENT:  Acting City Manager Smith, City Attorney, Hogin, Police Chief
  Dreiling, Public Works/Planning Director Rigg, Administrative
  Analyst Davis

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION AGENDA - No one came forward to speak.

At 5:02 p.m. Council recessed to Closed Session.

PUBLIC EMPLOYMENT
Pursuant to Government Code § 54957
Title: City Manager

CONFERENCE WITH LABOR NEGOTIATORS –
Pursuant to Government Code §54947.6
Agency designated representatives: City Attorney Christi Hogin
Unrepresented employee: City Manager

CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL – THREATENED LITIGATION
Pursuant to Government Code Section 54956.9
Based on advice of the City Attorney and existing facts and circumstances, the City Council
finds there is a significant exposure to litigation.
Number of cases: 1

At 6:00 p.m. Council reconvened to Open Session.

CLOSED SESSION ANNOUNCEMENTS
CITY COUNCIL
AUGUST 9, 2011 (Adjourned Session)
 Mayor Rea announced the City Council’s appointment of Acting City Manager/City Clerk Judy
Smith to City Manager effective August 1, 2011.

City Attorney Hogin announced the City Council approved the four year extension of the tolling
agreement relating to the Settlement Agreement and Consent Order Issued by DTSC, at the
former BKK Main Street Landfill, Carson, California.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC - No one came forward to speak.

CONSENT AGENDA

It was moved by Councilmember Humphrey, seconded by Councilmember Perkins and
unanimously approved that the following Consent Agenda items be approved:

 APPROVAL OF EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENT – CITY MANAGER

  RESOLUTION R11-23; APPROVING THE MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
  BETWEEN THE CITY AND THE PALOS VERDES POLICE OFFICERS’
  ASSOCIATION

  CONSIDERATION OF WHETHER TO FILE COMMENTS TO FCC RE: LOCAL
  REGULATION OF TELECOMMUNICATIONS FACILITIES

DEMANDS

It was moved by Councilmember Goodhart and seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Bird that the
demands of August 5, 2011, as approved by a majority of the City Council, totaling $253,566.48
be allowed and it was unanimously approved.
It was moved by Councilmember Goodhart and seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Bird that the
demands of August 9, 2011, as approved by a majority of the City Council, No. 519996 to
520008, totaling $17,734.78 be allowed and it was unanimously approved.

It was moved by Councilmember Goodhart and seconded by Mayor Pro Tem Bird that the
demands of August 9, 2011, as approved by a majority of the City Council, No. 520009 to
520055, totaling $182,696.28 be allowed and it was unanimously approved.

NEW BUSINESS  Policy Session Discussion Items:
   Disaster District Plan Report – Police Chief
   Sustainable Communities Initiatives – Planning Director
   Technology Initiatives – City Manager/City Clerk
   Citizen’s Academy – City Council
     Mutual Expectations – City Council/City Manager

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business before Council the meeting was adjourned at 8:35 p.m. to
Tuesday, September 13, 2011 at 6:30 p.m. in the City Council Chambers of City Hall.

  RESPECTFULLY SUBMITTED,

  JUDY SMITH, CITY CLERK

APPROVED:

WILLIAM JOHN REA, MAYOR

CITY COUNCIL
AUGUST 9, 2011 (Adjourned Session)
